fields.headline: Electronic filing is unavailable
fields.summary: The court’s electronic filing system and online case search are unavailable. The court is working to restore them and has not set a time. Deadlines are not affected by this notice; see the order of the presiding judge.
whatToDo: File on paper at the south security entrance, 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
For emergency protective orders, call the clerk’s office line and a clerk will help you.
Check the court website for updates before you travel.

fields.headline: Hearings on October 29 will be held by video or telephone
fields.summary: The courthouse is closed to the public. Hearings that continue will be held by video or telephone. The clerk will send each party the link or number.
whatToDo: Wait for the clerk’s message with your link or number. Do not use links from other sources.
If you have not heard by 8:00 a.m., call the clerk’s office line.

fields.headline: Jurors: do not report on October 29
fields.summary: Jury service is postponed. If you were summoned for October 29, you do not need to come to the courthouse.
whatToDo: Do not report to the courthouse on October 29 or 30.
Check the court website or call the juror line for a new date.

fields.headline: Notice to the bar: paper filing and emergency matters
fields.summary: The court is accepting paper filings for essential matters. Deadlines in the effective period of the closure order are extended.
whatToDo: Serve parties by mail or email until e-filing returns.
Send the joint list of affected speedy trial cases to the court administrator by 5:00 p.m. on October 29.
Direct questions to the court administrator, not to chambers.
fields.audience: Members of the bar, prosecutor and public defender
